description: Source code implementing a class to break variable aliasing in inner loops for shader compiler optimization, specifically for the ANGLE project. It modifies the AST to add '+0' to certain assignments within nested loops to prevent aliasing issues.

classes.name: AliasingBreaker
classes.description: AST traverser that modifies assignment nodes within nested loops to break aliasing chains by adding '+0'.

methods.name: BreakVariableAliasingInInnerLoops
methods.description: Main function that applies the aliasing breaker to the AST and validates it.
